subject: Verdant MAP: sprint owners, tentative dates, and resourcing compact
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@verdant.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Verdant MAP: sprint owners, tentative dates, and resourcing compact

Hi Marta / Andreas —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a compact Mutual Action Plan (attached) focused on the first 60 days: key milestones, named owners (Redwood + Verdant), and hard dates where we need alignment. This version is intentionally tight — we want clear accountability for the tech kickoff, data onboarding, and first pilot.

High-level (please review):
- Week 1 (06/23): Tech kickoff call — demo environment access, API keys, and data sample ingestion test. Owner: Karthik (Redwood) / Andreas (Verdant).
- Week 2–3 (06/30 – 07/14): Data pipeline and schema verification — sample ingestion success and KV cache expectations. Owner: Verdant engineering + Redwood infra lead. Acceptance: automated sample ingest & 1k test tokens.
- Week 4 (07/21): Pilot run (internal) — smoke tests, latency baseline, and cost estimate. Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Marta (Verdant).
- Week 6 (08/04): Production cutover window (soft) — final SLO review, runbook signoff. Owner: Customer ops / Redwood CSM.

Open asks for your team:
1) Confirm Andreas as Verdant technical owner for the ingestion tasks.
2) Confirm sample data availability by 06/24 (SFTP or secure share).
3) Any procurement constraints on the SOW timeline — Marta, are there PO lead times we should bake into the calendar?

Attachments: Verdant_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (contains a two-week cadence view + acceptance criteria), SOW_verdant_draft_20250617.pdf (draft, redlines welcome).

If this looks ok I propose we lock the tech kickoff for Monday 06/23 at 10:00am PT and use the first 30 minutes to verify env access, then break into engineering/CS tracks.

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0123

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@verdant.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Andreas Koenig <andreas.koenig@verdant.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Verdant MAP: sprint owners, tentative dates, and resourcing compact

Tessa — thanks for the clear write-up and the attachments. A few quick notes from Verdant: 

- Confirmed: Andreas will be the technical owner for ingestion and validity checks. He'll be primary contact for Karthik.
- Data: we can provide the sample dataset by 06/24; will deliver via SFTP (credentials to follow).
- PO/SOW: procurement flagged a standard 14-day review window for SOWs with vendor security addendum; if we want to start billing before PO clearance we need a short-term billing exception. I'll surface this to finance and let you know by EOD 06/18.

Couple questions: 
1) Can Redwood provide a one-page SOC2 evidence checklist for our security team ahead of the pilot?
2) On acceptance criteria for the pilot run (week 4): can we confirm an SLA target for p95 latency on a 512-token generator? We want to capture a baseline metric in the MAP.

If Karthik/Marissa are good to lock 06/23 10:00am PT, Andreas and I will join.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Implementation | Verdant AI

Karthik / Marissa —

Copying the Verdant thread so we have a single source of truth. Action items I need from you both before EOD Friday 06/20: 

Karthik:
- Confirm you'll lead the tech kickoff (06/23 10:00am PT) and be prepared to run the env-access checklist (API keys, service account, SFTP test).
- Identify the Redwood infra engineer who will own the ingestion verification (two 2-hour blocks in week of 06/30).

Marissa:
- Confirm you'll own the pilot-run acceptance criteria and the latency baseline capture (Week 4). Please add the specific metrics you'd like to log (p50/p95, tokens/sec, error rate).
- I'll need a short-runbook template (1 page) for the soft cutover (Week 6) — can you draft and attach to the MAP?

Notes: Marta asked for SOC2 checklist — I'll put together a one-page evidence checklist and attach it to the Drive link.

Attachments referenced: Verdant_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (updated with owner columns). SOW_verdant_draft_20250617.pdf (please scan for procurement risk items).

Thanks —

Hi all — confirming the items below so we can lock the calendar: 

1) Tech kickoff locked: Monday 23 June, 10:00am PT (Zoom invite to follow). I'll run the env-access checklist and validate API key generation live.
2) Ingestion owner: assigning Priya (infra engineer) for the 06/30 verification window; she'll run the SFTP ingest and report pass/fail with sample logs.
3) Pilot acceptance metrics (proposed): p50/p95 latency (512 tokens), tokens/sec, error rate (>=99% successful responses), and average cost per 1k tokens for the pilot workload. Marissa — can you confirm those are collectable in your telemetry?
4) SOC2 checklist: attached (one-page) and I updated the SOW with a standard security addendum. Please review SOW_verdant_draft_20250617.pdf and sign via DocuSign link when ready.

Next steps: Tessa will drop the Drive link with the MAP + runbook template; Marta, once you confirm PO timing we can wire the billing approach (exception or push to after PO).

See you on Monday.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
Phone: 650-555-0199
